EXPORT_PROMPT_FILE or EXPORT_EXECUTION_PACKAGE
→ attach or share the exact exported files to the external actor

→ accept or reject.

Before implementation changes, repository governance freezes one VISUAL_BASELINE_ID containing the exact source commit, deployment-resource hashes, supported viewports, prompt-box width and height behavior, relevant computed-style values, reference screenshots, and explicitly allowed change regions. A visual comparison may ignore only the registered dynamic regions.

An intentional visual deviation requires a specific normative UI requirement and a new human-authorized baseline record. Repository history is evidence for locating a candidate baseline but does not substitute for the frozen identity; if the baseline was not previously explicit, repository and deployment history identify the last user-approved state before the unrequested visual change and the resulting baseline is frozen before repair acceptance. Nonvisual work must produce zero unapproved visual diffs.

If exactly one qualifying predecessor state is mechanically identifiable, it is the proposed baseline. Otherwise, or when historical approval cannot be established, baseline selection is recorded through RECORD_HUMAN_DECISION with purpose VISUAL_BASELINE_AUTHORIZATION, and visual acceptance is BLOCKED until that decision exists.
candidates.proposition: Freeze one VISUAL_BASELINE_ID before implementation changes.

→ contract-profile migration

→ Stage 02 bounded-search and Stage 03 omission-challenge tests
→ Stage 04 obligation and challenge tests
→ Test IR language, dataflow, registry, parser, and security tests
→ deterministic runtime
→ file-first response ingestion and attachment-slot tests
→ workflow, due-stage, evidence, release, and terminal gates
→ prompt semantics, prompt-file identity, disclosure, and leakage tests
→ full-cycle and isolated mutation verification
→ local Chromium
→ deploy
→ exact deployed-origin and deployed-byte verification
→ deployed Chromium
→ actual physical iPhone Safari acceptance
→ final acceptance publication
→ release tag

Clean-profile and previously cached-profile acceptance must load one unmixed build identity or visibly block as stale. The running page, every script and style, and test-worker.js report or are bound to the expected build. Post-deployment verification retrieves every manifest path with cache bypass where supported and rejects missing, extra, redirected-to-different-content, cross-origin, stale, or modified resources. Browser acceptance proves the executed HTML, JavaScript, CSS, and worker resource graph matches the same manifest and build identity; mixed or stale cached builds fail.

ambiguities.issue: Contradiction test wording describes detection and sometimes direct block; §36.4/§41 cases 220 and 242 control final disposition: sufficient mandatory refutation means REJECTED, otherwise unresolved contradiction BLOCKED.
REQ × RUN × TEST coverage is a display label, not permission for all Cartesian cells; §§36.3/37 Stage 12 and §41 cases175–177 constrain due PER_RUN_REQUIRED relation universe.

Canonical mutations before acceptance=0 must be scoped to proposal acceptance requirements. §41 case221 and §52 direct-command rules prohibit requiring artificial human approval for application-owned calculation.
Artifact download/share and logical package export require actual available device route; combined share and deterministic archive are not mandatory substitutes.

Target freeze inventory includes detailed iOS/Safari/hardware observations, but minimum tuple expressly permits UNKNOWN hardware/WebKit build. Preserve both inventory and basis rather than infer stronger physical telemetry.
One atomic Stage 30 determination closes stage calculation but does not erase outcome-specific successful-attempt requirement in §36.11 or production-maturity attempt requirement in §50.
A governance change is an explicitly listed continuation when physical capability absent, not permission for implementation to silently relax the controlling specification.
Adapter conditions are conjunctive necessary conditions, not a requirement to build an adapter absent demonstrated need.
Real-project challenge list uses should; retain recommended normative strength and do not silently inflate it to an unconditional must.
Closed nested durable-object alternative means every named conceptual object need not be a new top-level collection; exactly one canonical owner and §14.9 registry remain mandatory.

Owner and family attribute rows retain all conjunctive fields. Reconciliation may split these into finer one-attribute entries but must not lose family/policy/authority conditions or double-count repeated obligation occurrences.

later_qualifiers.qualifies_earlier: Any blanket requirement for exact iPhone hardware model or WebKit build
later_qualifiers.rule: These two facts may be UNKNOWN; minimum remaining target tuple members cannot be missing. Physical-device fact may use recorded HUMAN_OBSERVATION.
Sequential per-member export satisfies logical package export when combined share unavailable. Archive is optional; missing required probe capability still BLOCKED.
Recorded performer HUMAN_OBSERVATION at recorded assurance is sufficient; it is not application-proven.
SELF_ASSERTED explicitly accepted for current purposes until authentication exists; any declared higher minimum blocks.
History locates a candidate; freeze identity before repair acceptance. Ambiguous/unestablished historical approval needs specific human baseline authorization.

later_qualifiers.qualifies_earlier: General completion versus full production maturity
later_qualifiers.rule: Functional readiness and real-project production maturity are distinct evidence thresholds; do not imply synthetic success proves maturity.
Atomic determination closure is distinct from export/transfer. §36.11 requires successful authorized attempt when requested outcome includes delivery; no Stage 31.
Closed explicit universe and independent evidence-supported EMPTY_UNIVERSE are necessary; label counts alone never prove completeness.
Due timing, required independent review, direct application commits and delivery/authorization distinctions govern broad completion language.
Historical schemas /2, 86 negatives, 3 storage failures and historical commit are supplied evidence only; cannot satisfy current profile.
